news.headline: Crude oil slips ~1% (WTI $100.75, Brent $109.65)
news.what_happened: WTI fell 0.99% and Brent 0.98% but both remain above $100/bbl.
news.why_it_matters: Falling crude eases jet fuel and petrochemical input costs for airlines and paint makers; effect is modest because the move is small.

news.headline: Wall Street closes higher: S&P 500 +0.7%, Nasdaq +0.82%
news.what_happened: S&P 500 ended at 7,676.77 and Nasdaq at 26,169.38; US 10Y yield flat near 4.99%.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-on cue for Indian large caps and FII-heavy names; Nasdaq gain is below the 1% threshold for a strong IT signal.

news.headline: Asia mixed: Nikkei +1.83%, Hang Seng -0.28%
news.what_happened: Japan rallied strongly while Hong Kong edged lower.
news.why_it_matters: Broad Asia tone is mildly positive; China weakness is a small drag for metals.

news.headline: Nifty closed at 22,753 (+0.68%) on Monday
news.what_happened: Nifty 50 gained 0.68% in the previous session; USD/INR steady near 95.18, gold -0.2%.
news.why_it_matters: Positive momentum into Tuesday; GIFT Nifty and FII/DII data could not be retrieved this morning.

sector_outlook.reason: Crude slip small, price level still high

picks.logic: Jet fuel is ~35-40% of airline opex, so lower crude directly helps IndiGo margins. Move is modest, so target is kept small.
Crude derivatives are ~40-50% of paint raw material cost; easing crude supports margin outlook.

risks: GIFT Nifty and FII/DII data unavailable this morning - opening gap unknown; if Nifty gaps up 0.5%+ reduce size
Crude still above $100/bbl; a reversal would hit both picks
Tuesday may be a weekly options expiry day - possible elevated volatility, avoid aggressive entries at open
